quotes.name: Alicia Hernandez
quotes.quote: To be honest, the A's haven't really affected my business or daily life that much. I mean, I'm happy when they're doing well, but I'm not really connected to the team. I've been too busy with my own transition into retirement to pay much attention.

quotes.name: Mariana Kapoor
quotes.quote: To be honest, I don't really know much about the A's success. I mean, I know they're the A's and they play baseball, but I haven't really been following how they're doing this season. My mom talks about the neighborhood and how people are feeling, and sometimes we see A's players around Chinatown, like Desmond Morton, he's a left fielder and my friend Eshe's mom loves watching him play. But I don't really know how the team's doing right now or how it affects our neighborhood. I just know that when we had that parade with the kids on our block, it felt like everyone was happy and having fun, and that's what stuck with me.

quotes.name: Pilar Ramirez
quotes.quote: To be honest, I'm not really sure how the community can benefit from the A's success. I mean, I love the team, but I've never really thought about it directly. I know my husband Vincent and I have argued about the A's and the Oaks, but that's more about our loyalty and curiosity than how it affects the community.

claim: To be honest, the A's haven't really affected my business or daily life that much. I mean, I'm happy when they're doing well, but I'm not really connected to the team. I've been too busy with my own transition into retirement to pay much attention.
